in_sanskrit.name: आतिथि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who comes to our house as a guest or a stranger. It is a respectful term used in Hinduism to welcome and honor the presence of a guest in our home.

in_hindi.name: आतिथि
in_hindi.long_meaning: The person who comes to our house.

in_tamil.name: ஆதிதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who arrives first or the unknown visitor.

in_telugu.name: ఆదిథి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who arrives at our doorstep.

in_marathi.name: Athin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Athin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Athin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prana' which means breath, life. In Hindu mythology, the god of breath and life is Prana Deva. The name Athin is believed to bring vitality and longevity to the one who carries it.
